SAHIL ASH +91 7039515582 | sahilash28@gmail.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Results-driven Finance Operations Analyst with 3 years of progressive experience in Investment Banking Operations. Expertise in complex data analysis, financial reconciliation, and validation of financial transactions and reports. Strong track record in identifying and resolving discrepancies, and contributing to process improvement initiatives. Proven ability to communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders, mentor junior team members, and maintain adherence to industry best practices and regulatory requirements.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Senior Financial Analyst | eClerx Services Ltd. Oct 2025 – June 2026 | Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra

Performed complex data analysis, reconciliation, and validation for Commodities, Fixed income, Foreign Exchange, Interest

Rate Products & Credit derivatives.

Identified and resolved discrepancies related to trade breaks, failed payment settlements, and data inconsistencies

within SLA timelines, maintaining high accuracy across multi-system reconciliation.

Communicated effectively with internal and external stakeholders — including brokers and middle-office teams — to clarify

information, provide updates, and coordinate timely payment settlements.

Performed reconciliation workflows using Advanced Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP), driving process

improvement and reducing manual intervention.

Monitored fund movements and ensured timely settlements aligned with global market deadlines (US/UK markets).

Acted as Subject Matter Expert (SME) in reconciling complex trade breaks, mentoring junior analysts and handling

critical escalations.

Maintained compliance with industry best practices and regulatory requirements in Investment Banking Operations.

Financial Analyst | eClerx Services Ltd. May 2023 – Oct 2025 | Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra

Tracking of invoices in internal system for across OTC products

Identified and escalated posting errors, mismatches, and exceptions as per defined escalation matrix

Performed trade reconciliation and break resolution, minimizing discrepancies and ensuring smooth trade flow

Attended client calls to resolve queries.

SKILLS & EXPERTISE

Finance & Operations: Data Analysis & Validation, Trade Lifecycle, Clearing & Settlements of payments, OTC derivatives,

Financial Controls, Exception Management

Markets Knowledge: Equities Derivatives, Commodities, FX (Foreign Exchange), Interest Rate products, Fixed Income, Investment Banking Operations

Technical Skills: Advanced Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, IF, Advanced Formulas), MIS Reporting, Financial Data Analysis, Trade Processing Systems

Tools & Systems: Appian, MS Excel, Internal Trade Processing Platforms

Soft Skills: Analytical Thinking, Attention to Detail, Problem Solving, Effective Communication, Stakeholder Management, Mentoring, Time Management

CERTIFICATIONS

Advanced Excel Certification

Tally ERP

Introduction to Gen AI – Technical University of Munich

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Management Studies (BMS) – University of Mumbai | CGPA: 8.95/10 | 2022

HSC – Maharashtra State Board | 2019

SSC – Maharashtra State Board | 2017

LANGUAGES

English | Hindi | Marathi | Bengali
